title: OID-See Findings Export Schema
description: Schema for the findings export produced by finding_builder.build_findings / generate_findings.py. Findings are derived artefacts — all risk values originate from the OID-See scanner graph export. This schema does not govern scanner scoring.

reasonCode.description: The scanner reason code that produced this evidence entry.

weight.description: Numeric weight of this reason in the overall risk score.

title.description: Short human-readable title for this evidence item.

summary.description: Descriptive summary of what this evidence means.

scannerMessage.description: The raw message emitted by the scanner for this reason code.

impact.description: Security impact description if this risk is exploited.

checkNext.description: Analyst guidance on what to investigate next.

falsePositiveNotes.description: Notes on common false-positive patterns for this evidence item.

direction.description: Whether this edge originates from (outbound) or terminates at (inbound) the finding subject.

edgeId.description: Unique identifier of the graph edge.

edgeType.description: Type label of the graph edge (e.g. HAS_APP_ROLE, ASSIGNED_TO).

fromNodeId.description: Node ID of the edge source.

toNodeId.description: Node ID of the edge target.

otherNodeId.description: Node ID of the node on the opposite end of the edge from the finding subject.

otherNodeDisplayName.description: Display name of the other node, where available.

edgeProperties.description: Extra edge properties forwarded from the graph export (e.g. scopes, permissionType).

findingId.description: Stable deterministic ID for this finding, derived from the subject and reason codes.

subjectKey.description: Stable subject key used for drift comparison across scans. Derived from servicePrincipalId → appId → findingId in priority order.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the app or service principal.

appId.description: Application (client) ID of the app registration, if available.

servicePrincipalId.description: Object ID of the enterprise application (service principal), if available.

publisherName.description: Publisher name as returned by Microsoft Graph, if available.

verifiedPublisherId.description: Verified publisher ID from Microsoft Partner Center, if verified.

appOwnerOrganizationId.description: Tenant ID of the organisation that registered the app, if available.

appOwnership.description: Ownership classification: '1st Party' (Microsoft), '3rd Party' (external publisher), 'Internal' (tenant-owned), or null when undetermined.

riskScore.description: Risk score from 0 to 100. Sourced verbatim from the scanner graph export — not recomputed here.

riskLevel.description: Risk level derived from the risk score. Sourced verbatim from the scanner graph export.

reasonCodes.description: List of reason codes that contributed to this finding.

evidence.description: Expanded evidence entries, one per reason code.

confidence.description: Overall confidence level for this finding, derived from the highest-confidence reason code.

recommendedAction.description: Aggregated recommended actions for the analyst, one sentence per reason code.

falsePositiveNotes.description: General false-positive guidance for this finding.

affectedRelationships.description: Graph edges that involve the finding subject, providing relationship context.
